content.short: Business transfers across ACH, wire, SWIFT, SEPA and stablecoins.
content.description: Karsa is a stablecoin neobank built for people and businesses in emerging markets, letting them buy dollar-denominated stablecoins, save in US bank accounts, and move money across borders using both traditional and blockchain rails. For businesses, Karsa enables transfers across ACH, wire, SWIFT, SEPA, and stablecoins, so companies can pay and get paid globally without stitching together multiple providers. Peer-to-peer under the hood and powered by USDC over networks such as Ethereum and Solana, it aims to be a global, censorship-resistant account that still feels as simple as a normal banking app, and pairs balances with a Visa card for everyday spending. A Y Combinator and Circle partner, Karsa targets the more than 100 million people underserved by legacy cross-border banking.
content.meta: Karsa is a stablecoin neobank for global dollar savings and cross-border transfers. Discover Karsa and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
